# EditableText

Text editing session channels and host verbs; pairs with kind `text`.

| | |
|--|--|
| **Role** | host |
| **Prelude** | yes (always in scope) |
| **Source** | `test-fixtures/pdl/stdlib/host_protocols.pdl` |

## Inbound channels

- `editingBegan`
- `editingFinished`
- `editingCancelled`
- `keyboardDismissed`
- `keyboardCancelled`

## Host verbs

- `beginEditing(startingValue)`
- `finishEditing()`
- `cancelEditing()`
- `commitEditing()`

## Injected state

- `value: String`
- `isEditing: Bool`
- `isEmpty: Bool`
- `isOverLimit: Bool`
- `activatesOn: TextFieldActivation`
